text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, Ines Fujin's injuries<n>amount to little
more than some<n>swelling in her legs, and she
suffers<n>no serious damage. Still, just to be<n>safe, she
heads back home to<n>recuperate for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After making a full recovery, Ines<n>asks me to teach
her how to run in a<n>way that won't result in her
collapsing at the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken aback by her sudden<n>request, but she
might be onto<n>something. We decide to make this
our main goal during summer camp,<n>so she'll be
able to race safely in the<n>upcoming Kikuka Sho.
